main_text.p: σύω ἔσσυμαι poet. pro σσυμαι, concito.
Ionicé, Poeticé, Æolicé, totum incrementum tollitur, ut δέχομαι accepit, pro δέδεκται: βλῆται percussus est, pro βέβλημαι, ἀ βλέω seu βάλλω.
Mutatio literarum in penultima. Attice in disyllabis habentibus ρ cum aliqua consonante, mutatur ε in α: ut γράφω,

page.notes: Greek text is transcribed approximately; several accents and breathings in the scan are faint. Some Greek words are uncertain and not marked individually.
